item.title: Scientists find cells that survive death and rebuild damaged tissue
item.description: Scientists discovered cells that can initiate programmed cell death, survive it, and then help rapidly rebuild damaged tissue.

item.title: NASA orbiter spots 728-foot crater newly formed on Moon
item.description: NASA's Lunar Reconnaissance Orbiter found a 728-foot-wide crater on the Moon formed in 2024, the largest newly formed crater ever recorded.

item.title: New snake species named after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash
item.description: A newly discovered snake from New Guinea has been named after Guns N' Roses guitarist Slash, a lifelong reptile enthusiast. Genetic testing confirmed it as a new species.
